original.statement: The Helm value etcd.managed (managed etcd deployment) and related Helm configurations were removed in Cilium 1.16.

decision.reason: [ev-d6d613eadc25] is in the 1.16 Upgrade Notes under Helm Options. It says the Helm option `etcd.managed` has been removed, so the subject (helm-value with path etcd.managed) and the change type "removed" are both stated directly. The note also says "other related Helm configurations" were removed, but it doesn't name them, so they can't be added to this assertion. The validators' inconclusive results neither confirm nor contradict it.
